## Selected Publications

::: {#refs}
:::

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const namePattern = /(Priestley,\s*L\.|L\.\s*Priestley|Luke Priestley)/g;

  document.querySelectorAll("#refs .csl-entry").forEach((entry) => {
    const walker = document.createTreeWalker(entry, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
    const textNodes = [];

    while (walker.nextNode()) textNodes.push(walker.currentNode);

    textNodes.forEach((node) => {
      const parts = node.nodeValue.split(namePattern);
      if (parts.length === 1) return;

      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      parts.forEach((part) => {
        if (namePattern.test(part)) {
          const strong = document.createElement("strong");
          strong.textContent = part;
          fragment.appendChild(strong);
        } else {
          fragment.appendChild(document.createTextNode(part));
        }
        namePattern.lastIndex = 0;
      });
      node.replaceWith(fragment);
    });
  });

  const sharedFirstAuthorEntry = document.querySelector("#ref-khalighinejad2021habenula");
  if (sharedFirstAuthorEntry) {
    const walker = document.createTreeWalker(sharedFirstAuthorEntry, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
    const textNodes = [];

    while (walker.nextNode()) textNodes.push(walker.currentNode);

    textNodes.forEach((node) => {
      node.nodeValue = node.nodeValue.replace(
        /\b(Khalighinejad,\s*N\.|Garrett,\s*N\.\s*E\.|Priestley,\s*L\.)/g,
        "$1*"
      );
    });

    const note = document.createElement("div");
    note.className = "shared-authorship-note";
    note.textContent = "* indicates shared first authorship";
    sharedFirstAuthorEntry.appendChild(note);
  }
});
</script>
